House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to State Government Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to state government; designating Ursa Minor as the official state constellation; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 1.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[1.1493] STATE CONSTELLATION. +]

[+Ursa Minor is the official constellation of the state of Minnesota. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
